text: The name Josiah is like blended incense,made lasting by a skilled perfumer. [AA]Precious is his memory, like honey to the taste,like music at a banquet.
For he grieved over our betrayals,and destroyed the abominable idols.
He kept his heart fixed on God,and in times of lawlessness practiced virtue.
Except for David, Hezekiah, and Josiah,they all were wicked;They abandoned the Law of the Most High,these kings of Judah, right to the very end.
So he gave over their power to others,their glory to a foreign nation
Who burned the holy cityand left its streets desolate,
As foretold by Jeremiah. [AB] They mistreated himwho even in the womb had been made a prophet,To root out, pull down, and destroy,and then to build and to plant. [AC]
Ezekiel beheld a visionand described the different creatures of the chariot; [AD]
He also referred to Job,who always persevered in the right path. [AE]
Then, too, the TwelveProphets—may their bones flourish with new life where they lie!—They gave new strength to Jacoband saved him with steadfast hope.
How to extol Zerubbabel? [2]He was like a signet ring on the right hand, [AF]
And Jeshua, Jozadak's son?In their time they rebuilt the altarAnd erected the holy temple,destined for everlasting glory.
Exalted be the memory of Nehemiah!He rebuilt our ruined walls,Restored our shattered defenses,and set up gates and bars. [AG]
Few on earth have been created like Enoch; [3]he also was taken up bodily. [AH]
Was ever a man born like Joseph?Even his dead body was provided for. [AI]
Glorious, too, were Shem and Seth and Enosh;but beyond that of any living being was the splendor of Adam. [AJ]
